name: Pagination
summary: Pages of a long list: previous, next and page links.

anatomy.description: Chips as links; the current one marked.

a11y.name: aria-label ("Pages").
notes: A disabled previous/next control is a non-link or a disabled button, never a live href with aria-disabled alone.
Loading more keeps the trigger stable; announce the count and offer a way to reach new items. Do not move focus unexpectedly.

platforms.web: nav.nd-pagination with .nd-chip links, or .nd-pagination--more with a button
platforms.ios: infinite List with a progress row
